spec_clauses.text: Concrete slab: grade C30/37, 200 mm thick, reinforced, on compacted granular base. Clause 3.2 of the structural specification.
Reinforcement: deformed steel rebar, 90 kg per cubic metre of concrete, laps 600 mm minimum. Clause 3.4.
Masonry walls: clay bricks, 50 bricks per square metre of wall, mortar mix 1:4 cement:sand. Clause 4.1.
Floor finishes: ceramic tiles to washroom, 15 square metres, adhesive bed 3 mm. Clause 5.2.
Roof framing: softwood timber, grade C24, 210 linear metres of joists and purlins. Clause 6.1.
Fixtures: 8 plumbing and lighting fixtures as scheduled on sheet A-102. Clause 7.3.
